name: claude-chromium-native-messaging-host
description: Native messaging host for Claude browser extension (Linux direct API mode)

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/host.js';const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('#!')){fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c)};fs.chmodSync(p,0o755)" && ln -sf host.js dist/host
